title: Drift detector
description: Doc comments, code examples, cited functions and paths, and documents the code moved past, compared with the current code

scan.title: Your documentation
scan.ignored: Skipped: changelogs, agent skills, templates, examples and generated folders (dist, build, node_modules…), which do not describe the current code.

issues.emptyHint: The scan reads every doc comment, every code example and every function or path cited in `backticks` in your .md / .rst, and git for the documents the code moved past, whatever the language.

detail.title: Selected gap
detail.emptyHint: Click a gap to see where it is and what to fix.

missing_function.label: Function not found
missing_function.message: The documentation calls “{{symbol}}”, which the code no longer contains.
missing_function.fix: Point the reference at the current function or remove it.

stale_reference.label: File not found
stale_reference.message: The documentation cites the file “{{symbol}}”, which is not in the project.
stale_reference.fix: Update the path or remove the reference.
stale_reference.fixMoved: Cite “{{target}}”, the only project file with this name.

outdated_example.label: Outdated example
outdated_example.message: The example around “{{symbol}}” no longer matches the code.

version_mismatch.label: Version mismatch
version_mismatch.message: The cited version “{{symbol}}” does not match the project.

config_mismatch.label: Config mismatch
config_mismatch.message: The configuration “{{symbol}}” does not match the code.

signature_mismatch.label: Doc comment out of date
signature_mismatch.message_renamed: The doc comment of “{{symbol}}” still names “{{old}}”, renamed “{{new}}” in the code.
signature_mismatch.message_removed: The doc comment of “{{symbol}}” documents {{removed}}, which the code no longer takes.
signature_mismatch.message: The doc comment of “{{symbol}}” no longer matches its parameters.
signature_mismatch.fix: Describe the parameters the code takes now.

type_mismatch.label: Type out of date
type_mismatch.message: “{{name}}” is documented as {{documented}} but annotated {{annotated}} in “{{symbol}}”.
type_mismatch.fix: Write the annotated type in the docstring.

undocumented_param.label: Parameter not described
undocumented_param.message: The doc comment of “{{symbol}}” does not describe {{added}}.

example_syntax.label: Example does not parse
example_syntax.message: A code example does not parse: {{detail}}
example_syntax.message_json: A JSON example does not parse: {{detail}}
example_syntax.fix: Fix the example so it can be copied as is.

example_import.label: Example imports what is gone
example_import.message: A code example imports “{{symbol}}”, which the project no longer has.
example_import.fix: Import what the project offers now.

example_arguments.label: Example call out of date
example_arguments.message: A code example calls “{{symbol}}” with arguments it no longer accepts ({{detail}}).
example_arguments.fix: Call it with its current parameters.

stale_doc.label: Probably out of date
stale_doc.message_one: {{count}} file this document describes changed after it, {{days}} days ago: {{files}}.
stale_doc.message_other: {{count}} files this document describes changed after it, {{days}} days ago: {{files}}.
stale_doc.fix: Read those changes and update the document.

doc_not_updated.label: Document not updated
doc_not_updated.message: The change edits {{files}} but not this document.
doc_not_updated.fix: Check that the document still holds.

errors.noProject: Select a project before running a scan.

freshness.title: Freshness
freshness.noGit: No git history: staleness is not measured.

fix.done_one: {{count}} fix made on the branch {{branch}}: review it on the card.
fix.done_other: {{count}} fixes made on the branch {{branch}}: review them on the card.
fix.nothing: Nothing left to fix: the code changed since the scan.
fix.failed: The fixes could not be made: {{error}}
fix.serverOnly: A server project's files are not on this computer: fix them from a local copy.
